unresolved: Fruit type and packaging of each juice are not stated.
Mercury by flame AAS without a cold-vapour step cannot reach the cited 0.001 mg/L limit; its non-detects are uninformative.
Summary text gives an iron range of 0.009-1.598 mg/L and mentions copper sample 9, inconsistent with Table 1 (51.360 mg/L for sample 5; only eight samples).
Arabic-numeral dates on the first page are not legible in the text layer; volume 9, issue 5, pp. 245-254.

regulatory_or_exposure.what: Libyan National Center for Standardization and Metrology and WHO drinking-water limits used as comparator (Pb 0.005/0.01, Cd 0.003/0.005, Hg 0.001/0.001 mg/L)
